metadata.description: Curated public-page snapshot prepared for the Property Signal technical assignment. Wasalt prices and listings can change; verify the linked pages before relying on them.
metadata.wasaltListingScope: A sample of listings visible on the public Al Narjis, North Riyadh sale page, not the full results inventory.
metadata.darglobalProjectScope: Selected projects visible in DarGlobal's public projects catalogue, with additional details only where linked official project pages were reviewed.

records.title: Trump Mansions
records.location: Rayana, Wadi Safar, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
records.description: DarGlobal describes a limited collection of Trump-branded residences inside Rayana, a double-gated Wadi Safar community overlooking a championship golf course. The official page places the project in Rayana, Wadi Safar, Riyadh.
features: Golf club access is described as membership-only

records.title: Neptune, Interiors by Mouawad
records.location: North Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
records.description: DarGlobal describes Neptune as an exclusive collection of five-bedroom branded villas in northern Riyadh with interiors by Mouawad. Its page says the project is near the Expo 2030 site and gives a stated completion schedule of December 2027. The page lists amenities for the wider community/neighbourhood, not necessarily inside every villa.
